profile.question: How do I create or update my profile?
profile.answer: Go to Profile > Edit Profile. Add clear photos and complete all sections for better match recommendations.

matches.question: How does MatchMate find matches?
matches.answer: Our algorithm recommends matches based on your preferences such as age, location, education, interests, and other profile parameters.

safety.question: Is my information safe?
safety.answer: Yes. We use secure servers, encrypted data transfer, and strict privacy policies to protect your personal information.

delete.question: How do I delete my account?
delete.answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. Once deleted, your data will be removed within standard retention timelines.
